newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan April aluminium output up 6.9 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan April aluminium output up 6.9 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Output of aluminium sheet and extruded products by Japan's seven major fabricators in April was 142,190 tonnes, up by 9,122 tonnes from a year earlier but down 2,138 tonnes from March, an industry body said on Friday.

The Japan Aluminium Federation said output of sheet aluminium, used mainly in cars and cans, came to 113,688 tonnes in April, down by 878 tonnes from March, but up by 6,731 tonnes from a year earlier.
Exports of sheet aluminium amounted to 17,788 tonnes, up by 180 tonnes from March.
Extruded products, used mainly in the construction industry, totalled 28,502 tonnes, down by 1,260 tonnes from March but up by 2,391 tonnes from a year earlier.
